english:
Firing generates Heat equal to the Heat Generated stat. Heat dissipates each second by the displayed Cooling Efficiency value. This works even while stowed.

Reaching 1000 Heat triggers Overheat, forcing a Manual Vent and preventing you from using the weapon until Heat drops to 150 or lower.

Starting a Manual Vent at 875 Heat or higher doubles the Vent Rate.

<primary/>Primary Ammo Balanced Heat Weapons intrinsically deal 20% increased direct damage to <link Elites, Minibosses, Bosses, and Vehicles [#CombatantClassifications] />.

source.text:
Firing generates Heat equal to the Heat Generated stat. 
Passively dissipates Heat equal to the displayed Cooling Efficiency value each second, even while stowed.
Reaching 1000 Heat triggers Overheat, forcing a Manual Vent and rendering the weapon unusable until its Heat is ≤150.

Upon beginning a Manual Vent while Heat is ≥875:
2x Vent Rate Multiplier.

Primary Ammo Balanced Heat Weapons intrinsically deal 20% Increased Impact Damage to Elites, Mini-bosses, Bosses, and Vehicles.

Additional information regarding Heat Weapons.
